description: Run a published strategy over real market history with parameters of your choosing. Returns its figures against its benchmark. Values outside a parameter's range are snapped into it. This is a real backtest, so make each one count.

params.description: Parameter values by key, from get_strategy. Omitted keys use their default.

range.description: Backtest window. Only these are kept warm; anything else is refused.

name: backtest_strategy
